lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Thanks for joining. Your renewal is 48 thousand dollars a year for 200 seats.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Last year we paid 40 thousand. Why the jump?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Well, the platform has grown a lot, and our whole team is really committed to customer success.
lines.label: evasion

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Can you hold it at 40 thousand?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Let me be upfront, I misspoke earlier. The renewal is 52 thousand, because I forgot the new support tier.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Yes, premium support is included, with a four hour response time.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: And what term are we signing?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: A two year term. The price is 52 thousand a year, locked.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Great. Let's confirm the annual price once more.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Right, so for the two year term it is 58 thousand a year.
lines.label: number_drift

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: And premium support is in that?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: We never include premium support, it has always been a paid add-on.
lines.label: contradiction
